notes.title: Hotfix for Steam API
notes.content: A small update to the recent patch, restoring Steam API functionality. If you missed an achievement, many of them will show up when you load your save or talk to a person. Others will require you to re-trigger them. We apologize for any inconvenience!

notes.title: Maintenance Update - 64-bit Mac Support
notes.content: We've updated [i]Ossuary[/i] and its demo, "The Hodge-Podge Transformer", to provide support for modern Mac OSes. Please let us know if you run into any issues!
